description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/varcoeff_laplacian_neumann_bc (conservative finite-volume variable-coefficient Laplacian div(k grad u), arithmetic-mean faces, prescribed wall flux) driven by problems/heat_1d_varcoeff_neumann.esm. The problem is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4) — no per-resolution fixture files exist or are needed. The manufactured solution exp(-0.75 pi^2 t) cos(pi x) + x with the closed-form MMS forcing S(x,t) = exp(-0.75 pi^2 t) 0.75 pi^2 cos(3 pi x) + pi sin(2 pi x) makes u exact for the continuous variable-coefficient PDE (derivation in the problem file); the wall flux k u_x = 1.5 (= qL = qR) is prescribed exactly, so the recorded relative-L2 and Linf errors at t=0.1 are pure spatial-discretization error, expected to fall as O(dx^2).

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

python._doc: LSODA at 1e-12/1e-14 keeps Python temporal truncation negligible against the spatial goldens on the stiff variable-coefficient heat sweep, matching the heat_1d_varcoeff_zero_flux pinning.

blocked_upstream_bindings.rust: Preemptively excluded, mirroring the same-operator sibling heat_1d_varcoeff_zero_flux: earthsci-ast-rs's diffsol integrator has no dtmin/max-step fail-fast guard and wedges (drives dt->0 without terminating) on this stiff variable-coefficient large-AST RHS. Julia (Tsit5) and Python (LSODA) solve it. Remove once the Rust solver gains a step guard.
